单调栈：仍然考虑每一根柱子左右第一个小于其高度的柱子。使用单调栈维护柱子的长度上.zh: 单调栈：仍然考虑每一根柱子左右第一个小于其高度的柱子。使用单调栈维护柱子的长度上升，如果遇到柱子长度变低就把不符合的柱子都弹出，弹出完剩下的栈顶就是左侧第一个小于其高度的柱子。而每个柱子只会被弹出一次，第一次使其弹出的柱子就是其右侧第一个小于等于其高度的柱子。注意右侧包含了柱子长度相等的情况，但是在这种情况下最右侧的那根柱子会保留正确答案。 单调栈可以解决一维数组中找到左右第一个小于该数的位置。如果需要确切的右边界，从右往左再扫一遍即可。
单调栈：仍然考虑每一根柱子左右第一个小于其高度的柱子。使用单调栈维护柱子的长度上.en: Monotonic stack: Still consider the first pillar on both sides that is shorter than the current pillar. Use a monotonic stack to maintain the ascending heights of pillars. If a pillar's height decreases, pop all pillars that no longer fit. After popping, the stack top is the first pillar on the left that is shorter than the current pillar. Each pillar is only popped once; the one that pops it for the first time is the first pillar on its right that is less than or equal in height. Note that the right side includes pillars of equal height, but in this case, the rightmost pillar retains the correct answer. Monotonic stacks can be used to find the first smaller number on the left and right in a one-dimensional array. If the exact right boundary is needed, scan from right to left again.

直接开三次根再取整会产生进度问题。预存每个数的三次方。枚举三个加和的数避免重复运.en: Taking the cube root directly and rounding can cause precision issues. Precompute the cube of each number. Enumerate three numbers and sum them to avoid repeated calculations.

在接收数据时更新每个点处放置炸弹时可以清除的垃圾数。在range()中使用min.en: Update the number of garbage that can be cleared by placing a bomb at each point when receiving data. Use min() and max() in range() to avoid case distinctions. Note that the square side length at the boundary can be less than 2d.

使用递推公式或使用队列模拟。递推公式为i=(i+m-1)%总人数. 模拟先全部进.zh: 使用递推公式或使用队列模拟。递推公式为i=(i+m-1)%总人数. 模拟先全部进队，再依次从头部取出并放回尾部，由此形成一个环。 队列的遍历就是拿出再放回。
使用递推公式或使用队列模拟。递推公式为i=(i+m-1)%总人数. 模拟先全部进.en: Use a recurrence or simulate the process with a queue. The recurrence is i = (i + m - 1) % total number of people. For simulation, enqueue everyone, then repeatedly remove an item from the front and return it to the back to form a cycle. Traversing the queue means removing and reinserting its items.

考虑转折次数。开一个旗帜变量记录上一次是向上还是向下。如果发生转折就答案+1。最.zh: 考虑转折次数。开一个旗帜变量记录上一次是向上还是向下。如果发生转折就答案+1。最后的序列长度即为转折次数+1.注意开头结尾，以及如果中间一段是平的也算一次转折。
考虑转折次数。开一个旗帜变量记录上一次是向上还是向下。如果发生转折就答案+1。最.en: Consider the number of turning points. Create a flag variable to record whether the last one was upward or downward. If a turning point occurs, the answer +1. The final sequence length is the number of turning points +1. Pay attention to the beginning and end, and if a segment in the middle is flat, it also counts as a turning point.

考虑连续上升子序列，此时会对子序列中的每一个人有约束。但是从左往右扫的时候无法以.zh: 考虑连续上升子序列，此时会对子序列中的每一个人有约束。但是从左往右扫的时候无法以O(n)的复杂度判断下降子序列。因此从右往左再扫一遍。left，right数组分别记录扫描过程中要求的最少糖果数，初值置1.最后每个人的最少糖果数即为两数组中记录的较大值，此时一定满足条件。
考虑连续上升子序列，此时会对子序列中的每一个人有约束。但是从左往右扫的时候无法以.en: Consider a continuous increasing subsequence; at this time, there will be constraints for each person in the subsequence. But when scanning from left to right, it's not possible to determine a decreasing subsequence with O(n) complexity. So, scan from right to left again. The left and right arrays record the minimum number of candies required during the scan, initialized to 1. Finally, the minimum number of candies for each person is the larger value recorded in the two arrays, which ensures the condition is satisfied.

考虑m×m的矩阵，首行为0-(m-1)，之后每一行依次向右移动一位。此时每一列都.zh: 考虑m×m的矩阵，首行为0-(m-1)，之后每一行依次向右移动一位。此时每一列都包含了0-(m-1)所有的数。删除一行，所有列的MEX值即为0-(m-1)，此时数列的美丽值最大。而当n<m-1时，直接取前面构造的n行，所有列的MEX值可以取遍0-n，此时数列的美丽值为n+1.注意特判一列的情况，此时美丽值为1.
考虑m×m的矩阵，首行为0-(m-1)，之后每一行依次向右移动一位。此时每一列都.en: Consider an m×m matrix, with the first row being 0-(m-1), and each subsequent row shifted one position to the right. At this point, each column contains all numbers from 0 to (m-1). If one row is deleted, the MEX value of all columns will be 0-(m-1), and the beauty value of the sequence is maximized. When n < m-1, directly take the first n constructed rows, and the MEX value of all columns can take values from 0 to n, so the beauty value of the sequence is n+1. Note the special case of a single column, where the beauty value is 1.

求完全覆盖区间的最小子区间数。按区间开头排序，往后一直搜到留下空隙的子区间之前，.zh: 求完全覆盖区间的最小子区间数。按区间开头排序，往后一直搜到留下空隙的子区间之前，取这些子区间中结尾最大的。 用二维数组会超内存，可以用数组套元组。
求完全覆盖区间的最小子区间数。按区间开头排序，往后一直搜到留下空隙的子区间之前，.en: Find the minimum number of subintervals that completely cover the interval. Sort by the start of the interval, then search forward until the last subinterval that leaves a gap, taking the one with the largest end among these subintervals. Using a 2D array will exceed memory, an array of tuples can be used.
